name: Terveystalo Oyj
summary: Terveystalo Oyj provides occupational healthcare services in Finland, Sweden, and Estonia. It operates through three segments: Healthcare Services, Portfolio Businesses, and Sweden. The company offers general practice and specialist medical care, diagnostic, outpatient surgery, dental, and other adjacent services; healthcare outsourcing and staffing services; child welfare services; and oral health, social, ER, well-being, and primary healthcare and specialty care services, as well as imaging and laboratory tests.
